$comment: Domain event catalogue (ADR-0025, docs/architecture/event-governance.md). Every published event is declared here; publishing an uncatalogued event and subscribing outside allowedConsumers are build/runtime errors. Field semantics and the schemaVersion policy (additive optional field = same version; removal, rename, or semantic change = bump) are documented in src/events/types.ts. payloadRule is one of identifier-only | identifiers-and-status | payload-permitted; SEALED entries never carry payload-permitted and never carry a payloadExemption (no exemption exists); HIGHLY_SENSITIVE_FINANCIAL entries need a payloadExemption naming owner, reason, and reviewer for anything beyond identifier-only.
